title: Molecular blueprints for cleaner air: theoretical insights into Cu(I)-decorated heterocycles for greenhouse gas (CO/CO2/CH4) capture
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,17983-17996
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08553E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Abhishek Bag, Gourisankar Roymahapatra
This study presents a DFT-based analysis of Cu(I)-decorated five-membered heterocycles—imidazole, pyrazole, thiazole, oxazole, isoxazole, and isothiazole—for capturing CO, CO2, and CH4.
